## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (for rules: bad fixtures, then good fixtures, then the rule)
- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, and `pnpm test` pass
- [ ] Changeset added (`pnpm changeset`) if users will notice the change
- [ ] Rule docs cite the PostgreSQL or MySQL documentation behind each claim
- [ ] No rule ID, config key, CLI flag, exit code, or JSON field was renamed or removed
- [ ] Docs and messages use plain English with no em dashes
